The 9-tier curriculum.

Nine tiers, from the first plan to a lasting legacy. Every course sits in a tier and belongs to one or more pathways.

The tiers, in order.

Earlier tiers build readiness. Later tiers build ventures, trusts and compliance.

  1. 01

    The Blueprint

    Foundations: goals, habits and the plan every later tier builds on.

  2. 02

    The Parent Playbook

    For families: routines, money talk and supporting a young athlete or scholar.

  3. 03

    The Recruiting Window

    Eligibility, film, outreach and choosing the right program.

  4. 04

    The Scholar's Foundation

    Study systems, critical thinking and academic positioning.

  5. 05

    The Career Launchpad

    First jobs, interviews, personal brand and professional basics.

  6. 06

    The Pathfinder

    Exploring options beyond sport: ventures, careers and identity.

  7. 07

    The Elite Level

    High-performance mindset, pressure and leadership.

  8. 08

    The Business Elite Level

    Governance, contracts, NIL compliance and running an enterprise.

  9. 09

    Critical Thinking

    Logic, fallacies and the decisions that shape a legacy.

Read the full FAQ
How does school licensing work?

We license the full Cool Nerdz framework to high schools, prep schools, athletic conferences and regional academies, with student dashboards and counselor tools.

What's the difference between the licensing levels?

Gold covers the core modules for athletic and scholastic readiness. Platinum adds institutional dashboards, custom branding and compliance alerts across more tiers. Legacy adds the full curriculum plus Trust Office guidance and live advisory webinars.

Can a partner institution white-label the experience?

Yes. Licensed partners can apply school insignia, athletic colors and counselor messaging to the student dashboard, within FERPA and COPPA requirements.

How do we request a licensing briefing?

Use the estimator on the For schools page, then send the briefing request from the same page.

Questions, answered.

Curriculum, admissions, school licensing, the portal and billing. The questions families and schools ask most.

Program and curriculum

What exactly is the Cool Nerdz Incubator?

A multi-tier educational incubator for high-performance scholars, athletic prospects and young founders. Each tier delivers structured modules, daily drills and progress tracking in the Cool Nerdz Portal.

How is the curriculum structured across tiers?

Sequential tiers, each with its own focus areas, estimated duration and outcomes. Earlier tiers build scholastic and athletic readiness; later tiers introduce venture formation, trust structures and advanced compliance.

Is Cool Nerdz only for student-athletes?

No. Early tiers cover recruiting, highlights and NIL rules, but several tiers are dedicated entirely to academic positioning, careers and entrepreneurship.

How long does it take to complete a tier?

Pacing is self-directed. Most scholars finish a tier's modules and drills in a few weeks of steady work; there is no hard deadline.

Enrollment and admissions

How do I enroll as a student or parent?

Start with the application. You submit a profile, configure a plan and, once approved, get access to the Cool Nerdz Portal.

Why are there regional caps on cohorts?

Recruiting and counseling resources are limited, so placements are managed by cohort to keep counselor-to-student ratios healthy.

Can parents customize an enrollment plan?

Yes. Parents and guardians can set tier selection, pacing and support needs before a student is onboarded.

What happens after I apply?

Your application is reviewed against cohort capacity. If a seat is open you receive onboarding instructions; if not, you join the waitlist for the next cohort.

School and institutional licensing

How does school licensing work?

We license the full Cool Nerdz framework to high schools, prep schools, athletic conferences and regional academies, with student dashboards and counselor tools.

What's the difference between the licensing levels?

Gold covers the core modules for athletic and scholastic readiness. Platinum adds institutional dashboards, custom branding and compliance alerts across more tiers. Legacy adds the full curriculum plus Trust Office guidance and live advisory webinars.

Can a partner institution white-label the experience?

Yes. Licensed partners can apply school insignia, athletic colors and counselor messaging to the student dashboard, within FERPA and COPPA requirements.

How do we request a licensing briefing?

Use the estimator on the For schools page, then send the briefing request from the same page.

Portal, privacy and support

What is the Cool Nerdz Portal?

Where enrolled scholars apply what they learn through scenario drills, such as redline contract audits and recovery check-ins, alongside their courses.

Is student data kept private?

Yes. Every portal experience, including white-labeled deployments, operates within FERPA and COPPA and sits behind authenticated, role-based accounts.

Can I use the portal on my phone?

Yes. It works in any modern mobile browser on phones and tablets.

Does Cool Nerdz offer refunds or plan changes?

Plan and licensing terms are confirmed during onboarding or the licensing briefing. If your circumstances change, contact the team through the application page.
